title: Imperial charter-and-guild culture
scope: Qualitative charter-and-guild organizing logic of the withdrawn imperial power and its drifted remnant expression at the outlet settlement; empire names, capitals, maps, dates, offices, collapse causes, rite content, language content, monetary facts, outlet-settlement government and institutions, demography, and all natural System behaviour remain open or unchanged.
approval_evidence: On 2026-08-17 the Author selected 'Option C — CHARTER-AND-GUILD' from the displayed multiple-choice options, accepting Option C exactly as drafted together with the proposal's shared claim set.
question: Which qualitative organizing logic governs the withdrawn power's culture — historically, and as the drifted living remnant culture of the outlet settlement — without choosing any empire name, capital, map, or date; any collapse cause beyond WLD-HISTORY-001's multi-causal frame; any rite content, language content, or monetary fact; any outlet-settlement government, law, institution, leadership, size, or founding fact; any claim that the remnant settlement is culturally uniform or fanatical; or any new System mechanic, readout, or CAL0 change?
selection: Use Option C — CHARTER-AND-GUILD, exactly as drafted, plus the proposal's option-independent shared claim set. The empire governed as a lattice of chartered bodies — guilds, colleges, companies, temple-corporations — each holding delegated authority under written charter; membership was identity, and law was charter interpretation argued between bodies. Full personhood in practice was corporate: standing ran through one's body, and the unincorporated had thin standing. Absorbed peoples were incorporated as recognized native bodies under limited charters or joined imperial bodies as junior members, and ambitious original-culture families earned or bought membership. The metropole held dense overlapping charters; the frontier ran on one or two bodies holding sweeping local grants. Virtues were charter-fidelity, craft excellence, mutual aid within the body, and honest accounting between bodies — admirable in part, for charters restrained arbitrary power and gave the low-born collective standing no lone petitioner had; sins were charter-breach, encroachment on another body's chartered work, betrayal of craft secrets, and letting a chartered work fail, and the same fidelity froze out the unincorporated. Faith orientation is a charter-granting cult class, belief only. Dress is livery, with body-membership and craft-mark classes and a forbidden-marks class. The ecological-suppression ideology held the wild to be unchartered ground made real only by charter, with clearance contracted to companies as profitable duty — a value, never an added collapse cause. At the outlet settlement, membership-identity and craft-mark pride persist, agreements are written down and old grants appealed to, charter authority has hollowed because the granting centre is gone so partial, disputed, possibly forged documents carry weight with no court able to renew or adjudicate them, and former branch bodies have inverted into sovereigns of their own function; the drift is contested and the remnant is internally varied, never uniform or fanatical by default. The imperial-descended households admitted into the ridge-spur settlement in its early days came out of this culture; that admission and its consequences belong to canon://world/shared-universe-001/culture/settlement-founding-fusion-blend and are not duplicated here.
alternatives: A — CENSUS-AND-LADDER: registered households as the administrative unit and graded civil, military, and works service ladders as the career unit, with advancement by examination classes and accumulated service record, personhood following registration, order-measure-thoroughness virtues against disorder and falsified record, a registry-cult class, graded uniformity in dress with earned insignia, the wild as the unmeasured, and a remnant of hollowed examinations, continuing household rolls, and inward-turned audit-virtue. Displayed and recommended in the proposal, not selected.

B — PATRON-AND-STANDARD: great houses holding client chains with identity anchored in whose standard one served under, advancement through patron service as the patron judged it, loyalty-largesse-protection virtues with genuinely owed downward duties against standard-breaking and abandonment, a standard-and-house cult class, house marks and client-mark variants in dress, the wild as the enemy's country and clearance as the houses' warrant and glory, and a remnant of persistent patron-client intuition, standard-relics, and siege-honour with house hierarchy hollowed. Displayed, not selected.

C — CHARTER-AND-GUILD: a lattice of chartered bodies holding delegated authority under written charter, corporate personhood with thin standing for the unincorporated, absorbed peoples incorporated under limited charters or as junior members, dense metropole charters against sweeping frontier grants, charter-fidelity and craft virtues against charter-breach and encroachment, a charter-granting cult class, livery dress with craft marks and a forbidden-marks class, the wild as unchartered ground cleared under profitable contract, and a remnant of persistent membership identity and craft-mark pride with charter authority hollowed and branch bodies inverted into sovereigns of their own function. Selected.
rationale: The selected logic makes the empire's inheritance argued rather than administered: membership, written grants, and craft standing give the outlet remnant a self-understanding that hollows into disputed paperwork with no court to renew it, which yields contested drift and rivalry pressure without any new mechanic, monetary fact, or named institution. It also leaves the original culture as a bare structural position, so every internal question stays with the sibling records.
evidence: Author multiple-choice selection on 2026-08-17 of 'Option C — CHARTER-AND-GUILD', accepting Option C exactly as drafted together with the proposal's shared claim set.
consequences: The withdrawn power governed as a lattice of chartered bodies — guilds, colleges, companies, temple-corporations — each holding delegated authority under written charter; membership was identity, and law was charter interpretation argued between bodies.
Full personhood in practice was corporate: standing ran through one's body, and the unincorporated held thin standing.

Absorbed peoples were incorporated as recognized native bodies under limited charters or as junior members of imperial bodies, and ambitious original-culture families earned or bought membership; the region's route of incorporation remains open.
Internal variation existed, at minimum between the metropole's dense overlapping charters and the frontier's reliance on one or two bodies holding sweeping local grants.

The virtue set — charter-fidelity, craft excellence, mutual aid within the body, honest accounting between bodies — was genuinely admirable in part, and the sin set — charter-breach, encroachment on another body's chartered work, betrayed craft secrets, a failed chartered work — condemned real harms, while the same fidelity froze out the unincorporated; neither list renders the culture simply good or evil.
Faith orientation is a charter-granting cult class with licensed patron-craft observance per body; belief only, with no cosmology, rite content, or afterlife claim confirmed.
Dress followed livery: body-membership livery classes and craft-mark classes, grade shown in trim, with a forbidden-marks class covering other bodies' livery and revoked charters' marks.

The ecological-suppression ideology held the wild to be unchartered ground made grantable, ownable, and real only by charter, with suppression contracted out to clearance-companies as profitable duty; this is a value, never an added collapse cause.

At the outlet settlement, membership-identity and craft-mark pride persist, agreements are written and old grants appealed to, charter authority has hollowed with the granting centre gone so partial, disputed, possibly forged documents carry weight with no court able to renew or adjudicate them, former branch bodies have inverted into sovereigns of their own function, and the drift is contested.

The imperial-descended households admitted into the ridge-spur settlement in its early days came out of this culture; the admission, its terms, and all its consequences belong solely to canon://world/shared-universe-001/culture/settlement-founding-fusion-blend and are neither duplicated nor extended here, and nothing about the ridge-spur settlement's internal cultural relations is established.

The shared claim set is also established: a literate, standardizing, engineering-minded culture that administered the original culture's region for generations as a peripheral holding of a power centred elsewhere; the outlet settlement as the primary living local continuation, carried by people through the withdrawal to a nucleus abandoned before re-occupation, on two separately running clocks with the span unfixed; historical and persisting internal variation; a late degraded inherited form after each recovery-and-fall cycle stripped further function layers; faith as belief and orientation class only; System-record use as cultural practice over unchanged natural behaviour; no imperial work, record, or institution surviving functional; and remnant belief as attitude and memory, not evidence.

Declared qualitative closure of WLD-HISTORY-001's open imperial-culture space: the withdrawn power's qualitative organizing logic — formal structure, personhood logic, virtue and sin field, faith orientation class, dress pattern, and ecological-suppression value — is closed to the charter-and-guild frame; within that record's separately open question of what the organised ecological suppression consisted of, this closure reaches one narrow element only — the contracting class, clearance let out under charter to companies — and the methods, scale, costs, institutions beyond that contracting class, and everything else WLD-HISTORY-001 leaves open about what that suppression consisted of stay open, while its name, capital, heartland, language, extent, formal offices and their counts, rulers, generals, officials, cycle counts, dates, map relation beyond peripheral status, and the region's route of incorporation all remain open.

Declared qualitative closure of WLD-LOCATION-005's open cultural texture: the outlet settlement's primarily-imperial character receives this drift pattern — what persists, what hollows, what inverts — and nothing further, while its name, founding date, the nucleus's re-occupation date and reuse history, size, population, government, leadership, institutions, law, defences, economy, internal composition, and minority presence all remain open, and primarily still does not mean uniformly.
The drift span stays unfixed: WLD-HISTORY-001 fixes no regional end date for organised imperial presence, and none is fixed here.

No closure of WLD-LOCATION-004's open remnant-attitude space is declared: recognition stays recognition rather than knowledge of function, avoidance stays practical rather than ritual, and no intact archive, verified grant, functioning mechanism, or working imperial machinery is created.

WLD-CULTURE-002 is untouched: this record's charter is the empire's corporate instrument class and fixes nothing about the ridge-spur founder charter-oath compact, and no governance claim is made for either settlement.

WLD-CULTURE-001's ex-imperial functionary or garrison descendant strand gains historical depth only; the lived attitude spectrum is untouched, no strand gains unanimity or exclusive System truth, and no strand, household, or lineage is assigned a body, membership, livery, or craft mark.
WLD-EVENT-001 continues to govern the standing rivalry as tendencies only; no trade fact, incident, envoy, negotiation, institution, or occurred event is created.

Charter, body, guild, college, company, temple-corporation, grant, warrant, livery, craft mark, trim grade, forbidden-marks class, charter-granting cult, and clearance-company are author-facing qualitative descriptions fixing no in-world name, language, title text, charter or code wording, count, calendar, measurement, proportion, price, or performance guarantee.
No quantitative demography, population, proportion, membership count, body count, date, duration, price, measurement, or Earth species, crop, or fabric is established; material classes only.
The culture is author-side truth, not automatic character knowledge, and the remnant pressures are standing pressures at story start, not occurred events.

No new System mechanic, readout guarantee, constant, notification behaviour, CAL0 change, or project-default adoption is created, the WLD-PRENATAL-001A guardrail stands with no effective prenatal practice and no reincarnate or exceptional individual referenced, and the parked sapient pack species, returning non-human peoples, and other surviving human communities gain no development.
residual_unknowns: All in-world names and linguistic expression of ranks, marks, cults, and chartered bodies remain open as protected unknowns; the language sibling owns the logic.
The original culture's internal frame and its lived experience under administration remain open to the original-culture sibling.
How the ridge-spur settlement blends this imperial inheritance, and on what terms the imperial-descended were admitted, remain open to the hybrid sibling.
The outlet settlement's actual government, institutions, law, and internal factions, including how drifted charter forms are used politically, remain open.
Which preserved remnant documents exist, their content, and their accuracy versus their believed accuracy remain open.
Historical imperial faith content, rites, and observances behind the charter-granting cult orientation class remain open.
Whether any local work, including the settlement road, is genuinely imperial-origin remains open per WLD-HISTORY-001.
How the remnant culture reads the standing rivalry and the approaching ridge-spur succession remains open as attitude only, with no occurred events.
The region's route of incorporation and the empire's name, extent, offices, and chronology beyond the accepted anchors remain open.
What exchange media, craft practice, material classes, and working arrangements the chartered-body inheritance can later support remains open.
reopening_conditions: Later accepted history, location, or culture work cannot support a chartered-body organizing logic for the withdrawn power.
The outlet settlement's later accepted government, institutions, or composition cannot be reconciled with hollowed charter authority and branch bodies inverted into sovereigns of their own function.
Later accepted work requires the ecological-suppression ideology to function as a collapse cause rather than a value.
The 2026-08-17 batch siblings' accepted content cannot be reconciled with the imperial-side inheritance recorded here.
The Author explicitly chooses another organizing logic.
